features: mechanical pan and tilt (no optical zoom)
infrared and white-light colour night modes
release_notes: Camera supplied in the official QuarkView PT825G 8MP PoE system with 8CH NVR (kit TA-6708KR-4-PT825G-80P, Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.); the kit page lists the camera model PT825G-80P at 8MP over wired PoE, with a built-in microphone and speaker (two-way talk), human detection, mechanical pan/tilt and infrared or white-light colour night modes. Pixel dimensions, lens, field of view, pan/tilt range, codecs, microSD capacity, IP rating and dimensions are not published for this variant. ONVIF/RTSP support and the RTSP path come from the linked PT825 PoE camera family manual (main stream only; default user admin with an empty password, default IP 192.168.1.10).

frigate.notes: Main-stream path from the QuarkView PT825 PoE family manual (Xiongmai/iCSee platform). The manual does not document a sub-stream; confirm one via ONVIF discovery before using it for detect. Set a password first: the factory password is empty.

home_assistant.notes: Use the ONVIF integration; the manual lists ONVIF support but not the ONVIF port.

blue_iris.notes: Add as a generic ONVIF/RTSP camera (Xiongmai/iCSee platform).
